# defer f()? with a nil result leaves the error result nil with no allocation.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos test ./...
stdout '^ok\s+example\.com/deferalloc'
! stdout 'no test files'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/deferalloc

go 1.27

-- alloc.lgo --
package deferalloc

func closeNil() error { return nil }

func ReturnNil() error {
	defer closeNil()?
	return nil
}

-- alloc_test.lgo --
package deferalloc

import "testing"

//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
func TestDeferTryNilAllocs(t *testing.T) {
	if n := testing.AllocsPerRun(200, func() { _ = ReturnNil() }); n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("defer f()? with nil result allocated %d times, want 0", n)
	}
	if err := ReturnNil(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ReturnNil() = %v, want nil", err)
	}
}
